title: ADD CONSTRAINT without NOT VALID — holds AccessExclusiveLock during full validation
expected_feedback: Critical: Adding an FK without NOT VALID scans all 8M rows while holding ShareRowExclusive on orders AND on the referenced users table -- writes block on both tables for the whole scan (reads are unaffected; ADD FOREIGN KEY is not AccessExclusive). Use the two-step pattern: ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID (brief lock), then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT (ShareUpdateExclusive on orders plus RowShare on users). Note FK constraints on a partitioned table may not be declared NOT VALID. Also: SET LOCAL outside a transaction block has no effect.
